Event fields, filters and ordering are unchanged. status allows up to 500 candidates and returns event_cursors for resuming after each row; full keeps its 100-row cap. card keeps all visible markets with card identity, quotes, lifecycle and selection fields, plus rewards and fee enrichment and market translations; its cap is 100 and it omits event_cursors. Requires include_markets=true (the default).

fields.description: Facets assigned to the market, with their ancestors; a market does not carry its event's facets. Present only when the request sets include_facets=true. Read-only.

Which mechanism resolves the market once UMA reports P3 (Scalar Resolutions): none (no workflow is started; the market stays unresolved on-chain until an operator changes the mode), equal_split (50/50) or lfmp (a settlement price — the last fair market price — is supplied by the resolution tooling). Defaults to none at creation and can be changed at any time, including after deployment. Gamma does not validate the mode against the market type.

fields.description: Parent v2 on-chain event ID: bytes32 hex with the bottom 3 bytes zero, equal to the v2 conditionId with its conditionIndex cleared. Shared by every market of a neg-risk event. Only present on v2 markets. Read-only: derived from the v2 conditionId; writes are rejected unless echoing the stored value.

V2 oracle request ID (bytes32 hex): the key the OracleAggregator resolves the market under. Equals the conditionId for binary and incremental neg-risk markets, and the onchainEventId for atomic neg-risk markets. Only present on v2 markets. Auto-derived for binary markets; for neg-risk markets it is set at creation and must equal the conditionId or the onchainEventId.

How the market resolves: oracle (resolved through an oracle request) or derived (payouts are supplied by the resolution service, no independent oracle request). Computed by Gamma at creation and fixed afterwards; read-only. Independent of resolutionSource, which stays free-text provider metadata.

High-level resolution state of the market: inactive (drafted, not yet deployed on chain), active (deployed, not resolved yet) or resolved. Only written for v2 markets; v1 markets keep using umaResolutionStatus.

fields.description: Facets assigned to the market, with their ancestors; a market does not carry its event's facets. Present only when the request sets include_facets=true. Read-only.

Which mechanism resolves the market once UMA reports P3 (Scalar Resolutions): none (no workflow is started; the market stays unresolved on-chain until an operator changes the mode), equal_split (50/50) or lfmp (a settlement price — the last fair market price — is supplied by the resolution tooling). Defaults to none at creation and can be changed at any time, including after deployment. Gamma does not validate the mode against the market type.

fields.description: Parent v2 on-chain event ID: bytes32 hex with the bottom 3 bytes zero, equal to the v2 conditionId with its conditionIndex cleared. Shared by every market of a neg-risk event. Only present on v2 markets. Read-only: derived from the v2 conditionId; writes are rejected unless echoing the stored value.

V2 oracle request ID (bytes32 hex): the key the OracleAggregator resolves the market under. Equals the conditionId for binary and incremental neg-risk markets, and the onchainEventId for atomic neg-risk markets. Only present on v2 markets. Auto-derived for binary markets; for neg-risk markets it is set at creation and must equal the conditionId or the onchainEventId.

How the market resolves: oracle (resolved through an oracle request) or derived (payouts are supplied by the resolution service, no independent oracle request). Computed by Gamma at creation and fixed afterwards; read-only. Independent of resolutionSource, which stays free-text provider metadata.

High-level resolution state of the market: inactive (drafted, not yet deployed on chain), active (deployed, not resolved yet) or resolved. Only written for v2 markets; v1 markets keep using umaResolutionStatus.

fields.description: Facets assigned to the market, with their ancestors; a market does not carry its event's facets. Present only when the request sets include_facets=true. Read-only.

Which mechanism resolves the market once UMA reports P3 (Scalar Resolutions): none (no workflow is started; the market stays unresolved on-chain until an operator changes the mode), equal_split (50/50) or lfmp (a settlement price — the last fair market price — is supplied by the resolution tooling). Defaults to none at creation and can be changed at any time, including after deployment. Gamma does not validate the mode against the market type.

fields.description: Parent v2 on-chain event ID: bytes32 hex with the bottom 3 bytes zero, equal to the v2 conditionId with its conditionIndex cleared. Shared by every market of a neg-risk event. Only present on v2 markets. Read-only: derived from the v2 conditionId; writes are rejected unless echoing the stored value.

V2 oracle request ID (bytes32 hex): the key the OracleAggregator resolves the market under. Equals the conditionId for binary and incremental neg-risk markets, and the onchainEventId for atomic neg-risk markets. Only present on v2 markets. Auto-derived for binary markets; for neg-risk markets it is set at creation and must equal the conditionId or the onchainEventId.

How the market resolves: oracle (resolved through an oracle request) or derived (payouts are supplied by the resolution service, no independent oracle request). Computed by Gamma at creation and fixed afterwards; read-only. Independent of resolutionSource, which stays free-text provider metadata.

High-level resolution state of the market: inactive (drafted, not yet deployed on chain), active (deployed, not resolved yet) or resolved. Only written for v2 markets; v1 markets keep using umaResolutionStatus.

fields.description: Whether the market can trade. Computed by Gamma at creation and fixed afterwards; read-only. Always present, false is explicit. Non-tradable markets are excluded from public discovery lists and search but stay readable by id, condition id, token id and position id.
Protocol version the market trades on: v1 (legacy CTF/CLOB) or v2 (polymarket-v2 modules). Clients must match exact values and treat unknown values as unsupported.
